note: Design only — no production code consulted. Open policy not asserted.

requirements.statement: Registered course opens dedicated workspace; access restricted to enrolled/linked users; displays syllabus, schedule, instructor(s), TA(s).
Faculty upload/organize materials; may schedule future release; Students/TAs/Observers read-only access to published materials.
Faculty/TAs post announcements; timestamped; visible to all enrolled/linked users; notification channel TBD.
Faculty create assignments with due date/instructions/submission type/points; draft before publication; visibility follows release date.
Students submit file/text/link before due date; view own history/status (submitted/late/missing); late handling and resubmission TBD.
Faculty/TAs grade with points+feedback; draft until released; released = read-only; post-release changes logged with who/when.
